US-37: Returns all ACTIVE employees assigned to the specified team.

Access rules (enforced server-side):
- HR Manager and SysAdmin can query any team's roster.
- PM can query any team roster.
- Team Lead can query their own assigned team.
- 403 Forbidden if querying other teams or if non-lead employee / client.
- 404 Not Found if team does not exist.
- Returns empty array [] cleanly if team has no assigned members.
